command: set -e; echo HOST_ID; hostname; echo CAPTURE_DEVICES; for p in /dev/video* /dev/media*; do if [ -e "$p" ]; then ls -ld "$p"; fi; done; echo CAMERA_TOOLS; command -v v4l2-ctl || true; command -v ffmpeg || true; echo SENSOR_PID; ps -eo pid,comm,args | grep -Ei '[d]igital.?retina|[/]opt/entityos/voice/cortex.py|[s]ichtd.py|[w]ebcam' | cut -c 1-230 | head -35; echo SVC_STATE; for s in digital-retina.service frankenstein-cortex.service sichtd.service frankenstein-local-bridge.service; do systemctl --user is-active "$s" 2>/dev/null || true; done; echo SVC_META; for s in digital-retina.service frankenstein-cortex.service sichtd.service; do echo "$s"; systemctl --user show "$s" -p MainPID -p SubState -p FragmentPath --no-pager 2>/dev/null | head -6; done; echo TAILSCALE_AVAILABLE; command -v tailscale || true; echo TAILSCALE_STATE; if command -v tailscale >/dev/null 2>&1; then tailscale status --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import sys,json; x=json.load(sys.stdin);print({"BackendState":x.get("BackendState"),"SelfDNS":(x.get("Self") or {}).get("DNSName"),"Tailnet":(x.get("CurrentTailnet") or {}).get("Name")})' || true; fi; echo LOCAL_LISTEN; ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | head -22; echo END
